title: fix(pmdg777): fix EFB community folder detection for MSFS 2024
body:
## Summary
- Fix `InstalledPackagesPathNextBoot` key in MSFS 2024 SU2's `UserCfg.opt` being incorrectly matched by `StartsWith("InstalledPackagesPath")`
- Add default MS Store `LocalCache\Packages\Community` paths as fallbacks for MSFS 2024 (`Microsoft.Limitless_...`) and MSFS 2020 (`Microsoft.FlightSimulator_...`)
- Remove unreachable local build fallback code

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify auto-detection works for MSFS 2024 MS Store with default package location
- [ ] Verify auto-detection works for MSFS 2024 with `InstalledPackagesPathNextBoot` in `UserCfg.opt`
- [ ] Verify auto-detection still works for MSFS 2020 (Steam and MS Store)
